_doc: Showtime (1v1, 2v2, 3v3): win on crowd hype, not damage. Every showy moment adds hype to the side that made it: each hit (more for longer and more varied combos), a Surge, a counter, a guard break, a wall bounce, breaking through rubble, a knockout, a ring-out (the fall the other side caused) and a close escape (a breakaway). Lives are unlimited like Team Deathmatch so the show goes on; first to hype_to_win or the most hype at time wins, a tie goes to sudden death. Point values are under hype. Times are in ticks (60 per second) unless named _seconds.
